turns.q: Can I exchange for a different size or option instead of a refund?
turns.replyTail:
instead of a refund?

Yes, for eligible SPANX.com orders you can exchange instead of getting a refund. ✨

For non-final sale items, exchanges are available within 30 days of delivery for the same style in a different:

size
inseam
color

Exchanges are free, and return shipping is included.

If you want a completely different style, the best path is to return the original item and place a new order for the new style.

Let me know if there's anything more I can assist with.

Are any items final sale / non-returnable?

Yes, some items are final sale and non-returnable. Items marked as final sale are not eligible for return or exchange, and that messaging is shown on the product page, in your cart, at checkout, and in your order confirmation email.

For regular items, non-final sale products in original tagged condition can be returned. If you want, I can also walk you through how to check whether a specific item is final sale.

Do I need the original packaging to return something?

No, you do not need the original packaging. You can use any packaging as long as your return item is inside and your return label is attached. If you use a QR code instead, you can bring the package to FedEx or an approved Walgreens location without printing the label.
